meta.title: Client brief — Sagh
meta.description: A short brief so we can get to know your project and prepare a quote.

ui.intro_title: Hi, this is a short brief
ui.intro_title_hl: so we can get to know your project.
intro_body: It takes about 4 minutes, and most of it is tapping a choice.
After that we get back to you with the next step.
ui.intro_small: Anything not marked "Required" can be skipped. At the end, WhatsApp opens with your answers in a message you send to us yourself.
ui.many_note: You picked several services, so we'll ask two or three quick questions about each.
ui.contact_lead: Last step. Where should we reply?
ui.under_button: This opens WhatsApp with your answers in a message. Nothing reaches us unless you press send. Our website does not store your answers.
ui.under_button_sheet: Pressing this saves your answers to our follow-up sheet on Google Sheets right away, even if you don't send the WhatsApp message. WhatsApp then opens with the same answers for you to send.
ui.thanks_title_end: , now just press send in WhatsApp.
thanks_steps: A WhatsApp message with your answers just opened. Send it to us as it is.
We read your brief and reply on WhatsApp within 2 working days. If we need more detail, we ask a few questions or set up a short call.
We send a written quote with scope and timeline, valid for 14 days.
ui.thanks_cap: We take on one project at a time so it gets our full attention. If we're booked, we'll tell you the earliest date we can start.
ui.fallback_title: If WhatsApp didn't open, copy the summary and send it to us
ui.fallback_text: We don't keep your answers; they reach us only when you send them.
ui.fallback_text_sheet: A copy of your answers was sent to our follow-up sheet when you pressed the button. Send them on WhatsApp too, so we know they arrived and can reply faster.
ui.intro_small_sheet: Anything not marked "Required" can be skipped. At the end, your answers are saved with us and WhatsApp opens with the same answers in a message for you to send.

msg.single: Pick one of the options to continue.
msg.text: We need this one, even a single line.
msg.name: Type your name so we know who we're talking to.
msg.phoneEmpty: We need your WhatsApp number to reply.
msg.phoneBad: The number looks incomplete or wrong. Write it like 05XXXXXXXX.
msg.emailBad: Something's missing in the email, please check it.
msg.consent: We need your consent so we can reply with a quote.
msg.copied: Copied. Paste it into a WhatsApp chat with us and send it.
msg.copyFail: We couldn't copy it automatically. Take a screenshot or message us directly.

consent: I agree that my answers are saved automatically to Sagh's follow-up sheet on Google Sheets (its servers may be outside Saudi Arabia) as soon as I press "Send on WhatsApp", even if I don't send the WhatsApp message, only so Sagh can prepare a quote and contact me about it, and that they are deleted after 12 months if no project starts. I am 18 or older and can withdraw consent or ask to correct or delete my data at any time on WhatsApp.
